tasks.title: E30 in full from its design
tasks.brief: You are the only coder on epic E30 (Teach and check). Implement it in full from its design docs/tdd/E30.md: every section, and every R, V and D of its acceptance matrix with a test, including end to end tests on the real stack. docs/build/E30/PLAN.md and ticket_tasks in docs/build/E30/tasks.json describe one split of this work with briefs, tests and gates: use them as a guide and checklist; the design and docs/SYSTEM.md win where they differ. Build in this order: domain, application, adapters, api, user interface, and run your tests as you go. If an epic you depend on has no code yet, code against its port protocol and the kernel fakes (docs/SYSTEM.md section 10). docs/SYSTEM.md section 4.3 names the camera package crew_health_camera; the design's crew_camera is wrong. Build the analyzer in workers/camera/src/crew_health_camera/analyzers/compression_rate/ and list this as a design correction.

ticket_tasks.title: Teach workflow, configuration and durable hub boundary
ticket_tasks.brief:
Read AGENTS.md, docs/SYSTEM.md and docs/requests/COORDINATOR-DECISIONS.md Part A first, then the remaining reads in order. Apply every AGENTS section 6 rule. docs/build/E30/PLAN.md records binding design deviations and coordinator handoffs; the design is frozen. Do not edit outside owned_paths, run git, modify a provider, add a shared type, or write an em dash, en dash or spaced hyphen as punctuation. Only implement after independent plan approval. Before touching a path, recheck other docs/build/*/tasks.json for new ownership claims. A missing prerequisite is blocked work, never a skip, xfail, permissive fake, sample-data fallback or successful acceptance. Use SYSTEM 10 kernel.testing fakes and the published port protocols for unit development when a provider is absent. Fakes never become production fallbacks or replace hub modules in acceptance. Report gate failures, unrun evidence and unresolved requests. Coordinator records AI-use rows and independent review/CI evidence outside your ownership.

Build the single teach hub module and its configuration, not the camera worker, UI, venue collection or cross-epic acceptance runner. Keeping commands, repositories and their privacy-sensitive drill composition under one owner avoids parallel edits to shared state and persistence. Scope is E30 sections 3 to 6, 8 to 11 and 15, work packages E30-01/02/03 and the hub half of E30-04. Only use files under section 13 (docs/tdd/E30.md:1154). Add module.py and local architecture.toml through the already owned module root using SYSTEM 4.1, 5.12 and 6.4. Do not create E01 assembly, migration discovery, generated contracts, settings schema or workspace files. No hub code exists at planning time. Start against the supplied kernel fakes when E01 lands; pending shared interfaces require P30-2/3/4/6 before affected production wiring. Do not implement proposals as agreed protocols.

Use SYSTEM 5.1 IdFactory/require_id; 5.2 Clock.now/monotonic_ns/process_epoch and TimeInput/ClockCorrections with captured segments; 5.3 MissionClock for labels only; 5.4 Decimal Quantity/Unit, UnitRegistry and WireUnitConverter; 5.5 ProblemError/StorageUnavailable and shared envelope mapping; 5.6 snapshot-bound ReleaseHandle/ConfigReleaseReader/ConfigReader/ReleaseCheck/TemplateRenderer; 5.7 StorageSession, UnitOfWorkFactory/ReadSnapshotFactory, DomainEventBus, Audience and local projection registration; 5.8 command_identity, IdempotencyStore, ResultVisibility and CommandIntents where multiple transactions are needed; 5.9 audit; 5.10 Scheduler/ElapsedDeadline and 5.10.1 TaskQueue/TaskRunner for external work; 5.11 SettingSpec/HubSettings; 5.12 ModuleRegistry. No Clock.read, ConfigReader.snapshot, local UnitConverter, local generic retry queue or feature command ledger. No transaction stays open over a camera call. P30-3 must settle the missing executor and HTTP completion binding before implementing those calls, not a private thread pool.

Domain files are skills, guided_check, capture, agreement, coaching, origin and errors (E30:1155). Implement SkillCatalog.from_document, TeachStep, CountAgreementCheck, CompressionRateCheck, SkillDefinition, CountWindow, Attempt/AttemptStatus, GuidedCheck, AgreementOutcome and the section 3.9 invariants from E30:80,127,245,340,386. Fraction arithmetic is local to the domain: retain exact beat-count/duration ratios, signed differences and inclusive comparisons. Shared quantities at ports use SYSTEM Decimal Quantity with canonical UCUM units; only convert/round once at the configured boundary. Never replace SYSTEM Quantity with E30's Fraction Quantity. Preserve exact n/d attempt evidence so 60/7 is not evaluated as a rounded decimal. Ask P30-2 for the exact records append mapper rather than inventing ObservationDraft/AnswerDraft. Validate dimension, origin, finite input and uncertainty before comparison. Two cameras are one correlated source. IndependentReferenceReader.over_window remains unresolved under R-E01-17; import only the settled provider declaration, with caller snapshot/session, patient/mission/origin, proven window coverage and bounded limit. Missing reference yields no_reference; storage, integrity, authorization, configuration and I/O errors propagate, never no_reference.

Build all five configured skills from E30 section 8 (E30:919), authored flow references and source IDs, not literal UI content in code. Documents are skills-catalog, ui-copy, indicator-catalog, responder-flows, onboard-plans and role-rules plus SYSTEM's effective release/unit overlay. Pin one immutable ReleaseHandle and retain exact document versions through every command/coaching generation and client reload. Read no clinical text from docs/product at runtime. Register check 16 with all contributors and C1 to C6 as ReleaseCheck through module.py, not engine scripts/validate_contracts.py. Reject invalid candidates atomically, keep last good, never change an existing check or lower a warning. Validate placeholder sets, numbering, references, landmarks, canonical indicator units, count topology, timer/question fields after approval, finite bounds and requested capture provenance. P30-1 must supply X1/X2/X3/X4/X5/X6/X7 before full R51/R52 delivery, and centrally settle the no-manikin rehearsal entry. The existing drill_cpr_manikin requires cpr_manikin; never remove that supply requirement or invent a new scenario ID. Until an approved rehearsal path exists, reject that drill and keep fixed public teaching available without claiming the missing drill flow is complete. A clinical capture-gap threshold cannot remain an operational setting under D7. Do not ship a settings switch that disables CR1 to CR4. Pending tolerance projects null and yields only no_reference (E30 section 6). Q1/Q7 do not waive source/purpose/applicability; call GuidanceEligibility.evaluate using SYSTEM 8.2 GuidanceRequest/ContentRef/Requirements, map decisions into pure domain data and fail closed on unknowns. Display clinical-review status independently of eligibility.

StartGuidedCheck, TapBeat, ActOnGuidedCheck, GetGuidedCheck, ListCoachingSamples, CoachingCoordinator and GuidedCheckAccess implement E30 4.2/10 with SYSTEM overrides. API operationIds and paths are startGuidedCheck POST /v1/guided-checks; getGuidedCheck GET /v1/guided-checks/{guided_check_id}; tapBeat POST /v1/guided-checks/{guided_check_id}/beats; actOnGuidedCheck POST /v1/guided-checks/{guided_check_id}/actions; listCoachingSamples GET /v1/help-sessions/{help_session_id}/coaching (docs/product/api/openapi.yaml:7159,7261,7336,7433,7551). Use generated effective GuidedCheckCreate/GuidedCheckBeat/GuidedCheckAction/GuidedCheck/CoachingSample/Answer models, not handwritten shared DTOs. Creation compares Config-Release for active-release starts; context starts pin their context as E30 section 6 specifies. If-Match applies to actions, not beats. Preserve closed JSON and all nullable fields; pending X fields cannot enter responses or generated overlays until approved centrally.

Authenticate and authorize current operation/object/fields before stored-result replay. SYSTEM 5.8 identity covers actor, operation, normalized target, semantic headers/parameters and body; check lookup before mutable preconditions, repeat in the write transaction, reauthorize cached references. Beyond 24 hours accept only the specified authorized accepted_command receipt. Same body on another check is a conflict. No raw clinical response is cached. Resolve helper/subject membership, active EVA, accepted assignment and exact run/help/drill context via providers. Use SYSTEM RosterPort, not a new PersonDirectory; unresolved RecordRouting is P30-2/R-E02-9. HTTP taps are LIVE even when a camera is missing; SimBeatSource is available only under the explicit fixture profile. LIVE presenter data and every derived Answer/camera/event/episode link route to the authorized LIVE demo-operator record. No SIM measurement on LIVE records and no SIM persona episode on presenter data. P30-5 must settle the incompatible LIVE presenter versus SIM plan completion link; never silently complete with foreign evidence or invent a grant.

Override E30 section 10's officer/station blanket access with SYSTEM 8.3/D9. Officer rank and help membership grant no chart. Helper reads only the accepted task fields, revoked/closed grants end all reads/events/replays. Station gets fixed public content and broadcasts, no clinical guided-check values. P30-4 settles effective role declarations and full versus helper projections; never send a partial invalid GuidedCheck. Register local audiences for every stored payload field; per-person outbox rows are distinct and postcommit, not a new multi-person scope. Crew scope of coaching.sample is not a clinical access grant. Assistant/adapter actors cannot drive E30 or safety state. Use E26 HelpSessionReader.context/readable_by from SYSTEM 4.4 after its actual signature is published. Missing help/roles providers disable contextual enrichment, not fixed help or direct E01 manual entry.

Persist only teach-owned tables via sqlite_repository and migrations/0001_teach.sql: teach_guided_check, teach_step_done, teach_attempt, teach_beat, teach_coaching_job, teach_coaching_sample (E30:685). Enforce STRICT/FK/unique active check/revisions/nulls, additive migration compatibility and required correction/pin/command-task provenance once P30-2/3 resolves storage mapping. Never manipulate another module's tables. Declare every mutation's SYSTEM 5.7 replication recovery change; until an export projection is independently approved use export_projection=None, not an implicit peer or ground grant. SQL decimal text plus UCUM must meet SYSTEM 5.4/5.7, not bare rate_per_min text without unit. Accepted observations, answers and attempt history are append only for mission life. Use shared audit chain covering every field and command result reference atomically with state/outbox/replication/schedules. Valid complete manual counts survive agree, disagree and no_reference. Disagree stays retry and cannot complete a step, award practice or close a gap; preserve the current schema's null check observation_id interim while keeping the manual record link in the attempt, unless centrally approved X16 changes it. Retrying/cancelling resets every field in E30 3.2 while prior attempts/Answers remain. Answer writes at answer, valid question identity, helper actor, mapped presence, later supersedes earlier. No invented colon IDs.

SYSTEM 8.1 replaces complete_step: publish GuidedCheckCompleted(guided_check_id, plan_run_id, step_id, outcome, observation_ids) inside the finish UoW after saving the check so the E28 reader can see it. E28 and E31 own their handlers and effects; no E30 supply/practice write, and no duplicate event definitions. P30-5 must publish the canonical declaration and snapshot-bound PlanRunReader/GuidedCheckReader binding. Invalid/closed/ineligible plan context may leave the plan unchanged through its provider's typed no-op; never swallow a storage/I/O/integrity/authorization/configuration error to save the count. D13 permits only EvaluationIsolation's typed computation-failure handling, not a blanket listener catch. Test the actual handlers in T5 when available.

Count attempts enforce CR1 through CR4, exact current attempt identity, sequence collision rules, bounds and UTC-derived monotonic instants from E30 3.3/3.8. Any uncertain start, clock discontinuity, interrupted suffix, gap, process epoch change or unbound old packet leaves the attempt incomplete with its reasons and no rate/Observation. Corrections come from SYSTEM history, not a local clock generation. P30-1/X7 must close the old-packet residual before retry delivery; client_time is never a duration or medical observation timestamp. Cancel/cleanup detaches tickets after commit; real late E06 evidence is retained by its owner, not erased. P30-3 settles multi-transaction reservations so response loss after opening a window cannot start another camera job or return an obsolete acceptance.

DrillCheckRuntime and EphemeralGuidedCheckRepository are structurally unable to reach SQLite/WAL, observations, answers, audit, persisted outbox, command-response cache or replication. Health values never become skill scores/rewards. Recheck the running drill on every operation, bound TTL/entries, expire on end/restart and return NOT_FOUND thereafter. P30-6 must first settle shared ephemeral idempotency and live-only delivery versus SYSTEM 5.8's durable mutation policy. Do not implement the design's local deduplication ledger or invent a live SSE bus. Fixed practice instructions can remain available without claiming recorded drill checks.

CoachingCoordinator implements E30 3.7/4.5 with shared Scheduler/TaskRunner, pinned references, bounded generations and deterministic help-before-drill arbitration. teach_coaching_job holds feature lifecycle only, never a replacement queue/lease/retry store. Import approved CameraReferencePort/ReferenceWindowRequest/ReferenceOutcome and CompressionRatePort/RawRateSample declarations after P30-3, not copied E06 types. Startup reconciliation uses the approved bounded help/drill readers. All worker calls have settings bounds; no E30 work is awaited by the help entry. Drop unknown/future/stale/reordered samples at observation time with uncertainty checked, throttle by pinned interval, clear to null on silence/refusal/termination; emit no invented zero. No valid gate means no numeric feedback. Register every operational bound in E30 section 11 through local SettingSpec, with units/min/max/source and explicit rejection/overflow. The unlisted executor/buffer bounds need P30-3 rather than new guessed setting keys. Clinical gate values belong to pinned content. Compression stays Experimental permanently and SIM rehearsal earns no quality claim.

Write tests first, named with T30 IDs and registered scenario markers. Own every hub-level case T30-01 through T30-23, T30-27/28/29 and T30-32 through T30-38 as applicable to this boundary (E30:1067). Include Hypothesis state-machine/capture/catalog/beat/action/quantity properties, 92/96/10 and 65/96 golden outcomes independently checked against CONTRACTS, nonterminating ratios, wrong units, nonfinite/extreme/zero/negative/empty/max inputs, null tolerance on all operations, conflicting sources and origin pairings. Prove scratch label/threshold/step edits change behavior without code, never safety mappings. Every R51/R52, contributing R50/R55, V85/V86/V87/V96/V98, D38, EI8/EI10 and I30-01 through I30-19 maps to concrete collected test IDs. Test worker outage/timeout, missing optional providers, stale/future/late samples, saturation, restart, disk full/audit/outbox/replication failure, corrupted/missing configuration, UTC jumps/mission boundaries, concurrent taps/finish/cancel, target-changing retry, >24-hour replay, grant revocation and incapacitated/absent crew. Drill tests scan all persistent sinks including database/WAL, ledger and worker store. Test each exception class separately; broad fallback never hides a failed durable write.

For T30-16 and the module's critical-path HTTP tests run create_app(settings) through the real composition root with temporary real SQLite, real middleware/UoW/records/auth/outbox/config/audit and ordinary startup migrations. Kill/restart subprocesses with bounded timeouts before/after each finish write and commit, lose the response, then retry. No mocks inside the hub. Only documented external worker/device adapters may be faked; model and ground are absent. Missing hard E01/E02/E05/E27-guidance or missing requested bindings cannot become an in-hub fake acceptance pass. T5 owns cross-epic V/D acceptance. Done requires all task gates, every assigned test, per-file domain/application branch >=95%, full safety-condition coverage/complexity <=15, no unexplained surviving capture/agreement mutants, trace inventory and resolved review/CI. Shared validator must explicitly register teach; E01-only validation cannot earn this task a pass.
gates: uv run --project hub pytest -c hub/pyproject.toml -q hub/tests/teach --cov=crew_health.teach.domain --cov=crew_health.teach.application --cov-branch --cov-fail-under=95 --cov-report=json:/tmp/e30-coverage.json
uv run --project hub ruff check hub/src/crew_health/teach hub/tests/teach
uv run --project hub ruff format --check hub/src/crew_health/teach hub/tests/teach
uv run --project hub mypy --strict hub/src/crew_health/teach
uv run --project hub python -m crew_health.app.import_contracts --output /tmp/e30-imports.ini
uv run --project hub lint-imports --config /tmp/e30-imports.ini
uv run --project hub python scripts/validate_hub.py interfaces generated corpus trace safety
uv run --project hub python scripts/validate_hub.py coverage --report /tmp/e30-coverage.json
uv run --project hub mutmut run --paths-to-mutate hub/src/crew_health/teach/domain
uv run --project hub python scripts/validate_hub.py mutations

ticket_tasks.title: Compression analyzer and refusal gate
ticket_tasks.brief:
Read AGENTS.md, docs/SYSTEM.md and docs/requests/COORDINATOR-DECISIONS.md Part A first, then the remaining reads in order. Apply every AGENTS section 6 rule. docs/build/E30/PLAN.md records binding design deviations and coordinator handoffs; the design is frozen. Do not edit outside owned_paths, run git, modify a provider, add a shared type, or write an em dash, en dash or spaced hyphen as punctuation. Only implement after independent plan approval. Before touching a path, recheck other docs/build/*/tasks.json for new ownership claims. A missing prerequisite is blocked work, never a skip, xfail, permissive fake, sample-data fallback or successful acceptance. Use SYSTEM 10 kernel.testing fakes and the published port protocols for unit development when a provider is absent. Fakes never become production fallbacks or replace hub modules in acceptance. Report gate failures, unrun evidence and unresolved requests. Coordinator records AI-use rows and independent review/CI evidence outside your ownership.

Build only E30 section 5.3's compression analyzer, versioned gate.json/gate.schema.json and its tests T30-31, plus worker portions of T30-20/29/36. This is the design's reserved path (docs/tdd/E30.md:778,1161), subject to X8. P30-3 is a dispatch blocker: SYSTEM 4.3 names crew_health_camera, the frozen design names crew_camera, and docs/tdd/E06.md does not exist. Do not create a second worker package, compatibility shim, worker server, host plugin framework, transport protocol or pyproject. E06 must publish its design, plugin API, shared unit/clock boundary, toolchain/import checks and confirm this exact carveout before this task writes code. If the canonical path differs, the coordinator must revise ownership and this plan first; these paths are a reservation, not a permission to edit E06 infrastructure. No task silently remaps them.

Read E30 3.7/4.1/5.3/9/10/11/12.2, SYSTEM 3/4.3/5.2/5.4/5.5/5.11/6.2/6.4/8.1 and Part A Q5/Q8/D3/D7/D12. Consume E06's approved landmark/treatment-region and CompressionRatePort worker binding once published. Shared quantities are finite Decimal Quantity/Unit and corrected observation times retain source clock/segment/uncertainty, not bare numeric rates or receive-time freshness. Frames remain on the capturing device, never disk, HTTP payloads or logs. The only analyzer outputs allowed are valid RawRateSample values and contracted cannot_see_hands/quality_gate_failed refusals, mapped by the host. No hub state, clinical record, safety, text, practice or plan write. T1 derives catalog wording; T3 renders it; T4 owns analysis evidence.

Implement the seven ordered steps in E30:798 without alternative algorithms: select exactly one helper with both wrists in E06's treatment region; reject missing/multiple people and unsupported geometry; visibility and edge saturation checks; configured fps/gap/shoulder size; wrist midpoint relative to shoulder width; reject nonfinite coordinates, zero variance, stuck/insufficient motion and missing spans without interpolation; hysteresis troughs with earliest-frame tie resolution and at least three troughs; capture-time rate and configured cycle variability/range/rate-change checks; final validation-state gate. Retain exact cycle ratio internally and use the agreed unit-bearing boundary. Never infer depth, compression quality, rhythm, safety or independent confirmation from cameras.

gate.json is exactly the versioned draft in E30:784 with sourced bounds/provenance and validated=false. Resolve RS01/RS02/SK03 through the registered release/source material, not runtime package reads or web downloads. P30-1/X5 must move domain gate/precision values into an accepted pinned configuration binding; no unpinned mutable side file may change an open job. Until its binding and valid manikin evidence exist, production emits only refusals and the eval-only profile may compute candidate rates for the study. No setting, fixture or test flips the shipped gate to validated to pass. If invalid candidate settings are loaded, retain last good; if none exists, refuse. Numeric software oracle tests may exercise pure candidate calculations on SIM traces while asserting the production final gate still returns null.

All buffers/loops/frame counts/worker calls are bounded using E06 settings under SYSTEM 5.11. P30-3 must settle the missing ring-buffer and input-frame bounds, timeout/cancellation and physical stop semantics. Never turn a lost stop ACK into a fresh sample. Honor job/generation identity, lease expiry and late-result refusal in the host contract; let E06 retain any separately accepted real observation. Tablet browsers without a local worker supply no reference camera.

Tests first: T30-31 properties and faults traced to E30-04/R52/V96 and AGENTS input invariants. Clean SIM traces at 90/110/130 verify the candidate algorithm against an independently generated oracle, then the production unvalidated gate refuses each. Cover occlusion, two people, unsupported view, edges, saturation, fps/irregular sampling/gaps, zero width/variance, plateau ties, too few troughs, unstable cycles, rate jumps, nonfinite/extreme input, out-of-order/unknown clock, stale generation, oversized window and corrupt gate retaining last good. A scratch configured display precision/gate field changes output with no code change, never an edited safety mapping. Assert no raw frame persistence and that missing cameras refuse. Worker HTTP-to-hub V96 acceptance belongs to T5 and cannot pass on pure signal tests. Done requires confirmed ownership, real E06 plugin loading, worker type/lint/import gates, all assigned tests and shared validator coverage of the worker; absent project or undiscovered import contract is blocked, not a successful bare lint-imports run.
gates: uv run --project workers/camera pytest -q workers/camera/tests/compression_rate
uv run --project workers/camera ruff check workers/camera/src/crew_camera/analyzers/compression_rate workers/camera/tests/compression_rate
uv run --project workers/camera ruff format --check workers/camera/src/crew_camera/analyzers/compression_rate workers/camera/tests/compression_rate
uv run --project workers/camera mypy --strict workers/camera/src/crew_camera/analyzers/compression_rate
uv run --project workers/camera lint-imports
uv run --project hub python scripts/validate_hub.py interfaces corpus trace safety

ticket_tasks.title: Configured teach screens and browser fallbacks
ticket_tasks.brief:
Read AGENTS.md, docs/SYSTEM.md and docs/requests/COORDINATOR-DECISIONS.md Part A first, then the remaining reads in order. Apply every AGENTS section 6 rule. docs/build/E30/PLAN.md records binding design deviations and coordinator handoffs; the design is frozen. Do not edit outside owned_paths, run git, modify a provider, add a shared type, or write an em dash, en dash or spaced hyphen as punctuation. Only implement after independent plan approval. Before touching a path, recheck other docs/build/*/tasks.json for new ownership claims. A missing prerequisite is blocked work, never a skip, xfail, permissive fake, sample-data fallback or successful acceptance. Use SYSTEM 10 kernel.testing fakes and the published port protocols for unit development when a provider is absent. Fakes never become production fallbacks or replace hub modules in acceptance. Report gate failures, unrun evidence and unresolved requests. Coordinator records AI-use rows and independent review/CI evidence outside your ownership.

Build only E30 section 7's feature and its unit/property/browser tests. No shell/router/offline/identity changes, new endpoints, manual shared DTOs or configuration copy in TypeScript. The section 13 directory (E30:1163) is the complete write boundary, including browser specs. E03 owns components and shared UI scripts; E20 owns offline mechanisms; E26/E28/E31 own their embedding sites. P30-1 and P30-7 must deliver generated contracts, missing words, source/pin projection, mounting and Playwright discovery before dependent code. Work against generated API examples after those handoffs, independently of T1; final browser gates require its real hub. Pending proposed JSON is not an agreed TypeScript type.

Read E30 3.2/3.3/3.7/6/7/8/9/10/12.2, SYSTEM 5.2/5.5/5.6/5.8/6.3/8.2/8.3 and DEPLOYMENT 3.1/3.3/5.5. Implement CrewmateChecksScreen.vue, TeachStepCard.vue, BeatPad.vue, TapLine.vue, CheckResultCard.vue, CoachingLine.vue, TeachOnlyViewer.vue and useGuidedCheck.ts exactly as named at E30:860. Import @crew-health/contracts generated client/types and E03 public design/body/stage/copy/event/session APIs once supplied. No copied client, body renderer, template engine, freshness engine, command queue or script setup. useGuidedCheck consumes startGuidedCheck/getGuidedCheck/tapBeat/actOnGuidedCheck; CoachingLine consumes listCoachingSamples and coaching.sample (exact routes in docs/product/api/openapi.yaml:7159,7261,7336,7433,7551). E30 X1 rendered teach_steps/card_title_text/notice/pins and X6 words must be approved/generated before enabling this feature; do not author them locally or render state-dependent templates on the client.

Every catalog surface shows notice, provenance, release/pins and Experimental separately, including drill, embedded coaching and offline viewer. All five entry paths in E30 section 7 are required: wrist pulse from plan and drill, CPR fixed help plus teaching/drill, bleed pressure with its soaking-through question and contextual region, eye rinse with sourced timer and explicit helper confirmation, recovery position. X2/X3/X4 completion is mandatory; a static viewer cannot satisfy missing recorded teaching or timer behavior. Flow steps are resolved by the hub from the pinned responder-flows, never duplicated. Apply GuidanceEligibility results from the owning backend; unsupported/unknown guidance is disabled with configured human-path text, fixed emergency entry stays visible. No clinician/ground wait is introduced. Use E03 landmark region plus nullable model-coordinate offset, normal/reduced-motion/no-WebGL modes; no scalar or post-projection offset. Only request provider changes through P30-7.

Beat is keyboard accessible, >=44px, enabled only after start ACK and before the hub-derived end. Countdown uses shared corrected clock/elapsed semantics, not the browser clock as measurement time. Each tap sends immediately with immutable identity/body; never enqueue offline taps. Sequence is per approved attempt token, abort all in-flight taps before retry. Any failed/aborted tap, late start, stream loss, reload, unknown clock, lock or owner switch stops capture and shows configured interrupted/manual/new-count controls. A reconnect cannot resume an uncertain count. No fabricated buffered timestamps. Preserve If-Match, distinguish stale revision from authorization and recognize only SYSTEM 5.8's complete matching accepted_command receipt on 409; never infer acceptance from code alone or mint a new key automatically.

Results use hub text verbatim, count/camera origin per value and all missing/refusal/tolerance-pending states. Show both conflicting observations without blame; retry stays incomplete and the heart ring remains dashed. No ECG/rhythm/diagnosis claim, no citation of unchecked manual count as assessment support, no reward/streak/crew goal. Keep cancelled fields null on refetch/restart. Respect SYSTEM 8.3/D9: no clinical station or blanket officer access. Task-limited authorized views only, in memory; sign-out/close/revocation clears values, requests and subscriptions before any new owner. Offline store contains versioned public configuration, never GuidedCheck/Answer/history/CPR values. TeachOnlyViewer records nothing and cannot accept beats with hub down.

CoachingLine is static polite atomic text, no animation, transition, color flash or sound. At ingest/display, entire corrected observation uncertainty interval must be current and not future. Expire via the approved valid_until or proven pinned interval; unknown clock/pin means immediately not current. Clear on SSE loss, hub unreachable, terminal flow/drill, stop, owner change or stale replay. Reconnect history never revives a current line; only newer valid samples replace it. No hardcoded fallback 1-second domain cadence. No numeric rate for unvalidated gate/rehearsal. Missing manikin permits only the centrally approved SIM rehearsal entry, with no CPR quality claim; drill_cpr_manikin still requires its configured supply. Until that entry lands, show the configured unavailable path and retain fixed teaching, never waive supplies. Fixed help steps and navigation remain usable throughout; CoachingLine errors cannot block entry.

Tests first: T30-24/25/26 and UI portions T30-34/36/38 (E30:1090), traced R51/R52/V85/V86/V87/V96/V98/D38, I30-11/12/14/15/17/18/19, EI8/EI10. Unit/fast-check tests cover schema/copy edits, ordered steps, first-time mode, inclusive result boundaries rendered from hub responses, nulls and all origins, timers, landmarks/offsets, keyboard/focus/zoom/reduced motion/no-WebGL, provenance on all surfaces and scan for domain display literals. Browser specs run against a normally launched real hub/composition root/temporary real SQLite and the explicit E21 fixture, with model/device/ground absent and only documented external worker fakes. No route interception or in-hub mock. Drive T30-26 Act 5 from Teach Tomas through every step, complete window, answer and result; assert actual event times, operator/record routing and dashed gap beside measured pulse. Cover no camera/poor signal and V96 below-band then hidden hands, stream expiry/disconnect/hub death, stale replay, offline cached teaching, old/missing pins, corrupted update, concurrent finish/cancel, failed persistence, adversarial other-owner access, closed help, incapacitated subject and lock while a response is in flight. Fail if required providers or positive cases are absent. Keep browser traces as private test evidence through E21's approved artifact handoff. Done requires all feature lint/types/unit/Playwright gates and every assigned surface/scenario; handoff missing provider mounts to the coordinator, never patch their paths.
gates: pnpm -C ui/crew typecheck
pnpm -C ui/crew lint
pnpm -C ui/crew test features/teach
pnpm -C ui/crew exec playwright test src/features/teach

ticket_tasks.brief:
Read AGENTS.md, docs/SYSTEM.md and docs/requests/COORDINATOR-DECISIONS.md Part A first, then the remaining reads in order. Apply every AGENTS section 6 rule. docs/build/E30/PLAN.md records binding design deviations and coordinator handoffs; the design is frozen. Do not edit outside owned_paths, run git, modify a provider, add a shared type, or write an em dash, en dash or spaced hyphen as punctuation. Only implement after independent plan approval. Before touching a path, recheck other docs/build/*/tasks.json for new ownership claims. A missing prerequisite is blocked work, never a skip, xfail, permissive fake, sample-data fallback or successful acceptance. Use SYSTEM 10 kernel.testing fakes and the published port protocols for unit development when a provider is absent. Fakes never become production fallbacks or replace hub modules in acceptance. Report gate failures, unrun evidence and unresolved requests. Coordinator records AI-use rows and independent review/CI evidence outside your ownership.

Own only E30 scenario implementations and evidence assertions under eval/scenarios/teach_and_check (E30:1165). This test task does not edit product code or repeat other tasks' implementation. E21 owns shared conftest, runner, fixture, registry and reports. Write scenario definitions against the source now, then run after hard providers and P30 handoffs land. No mocks inside hub, no synthetic replacement module, no manually inserted accepted record bypassing provider validation, no response-only or pure-domain case counted as end to end. Actual HTTP always enters SYSTEM create_app(settings) composition root and a fresh temporary real SQLite database with real auth/config/records/audit/outbox/ledger/migrations and teach registration. Browser evidence uses T3's real Playwright flow. Model, forecast, kit devices and ground are stopped/absent except where a documented external SIM worker fake supplies the explicit test source. Any missing application provider remains blocked acceptance. Unit tests may use kernel.testing; these scenarios may not.

Sources: E30 sections 9/10/11/12/15, SYSTEM 5.1 through 5.12, 6, 8.1/8.2/8.3/8.6/8.7, 9/10; product VALIDATION V85/V86/V87/V96/D38 at docs/product/VALIDATION.md:105,116,193, plus V98 content-edit obligation. Trace each test by T30 ID and registered bare V85/V86/V87/V96/D38/V98 marker, R51/R52 and contributing R50/R55, EI8/EI10 and relevant I30 invariants. Add a collection assertion within this owned suite requiring every listed scenario and critical-path case to collect; a nonempty broad OR selection alone is insufficient. No alternate marker convention, -k, skipped requirement or pass from zero tests. P30-9 must register markers and exact collected provider nodes in E21's registry and teach coverage/trace/mutation scope in E01's validator before the gate is meaningful.

V85/T30-02 and D38/T30-08/13/23/26: authenticated helper/subject and accepted role/run start; rendered instruction steps, clock-stamped complete count, answer at answer, finish. Golden count 92/60s versus 96 with tolerance 10 yields agree/difference -4. Assert exactly one valid crewmate_palpation Observation/operator/body region/source/pin, E01 Answer and transactional domain event; actual E28 handler completes eligible step once. No ECG inference, CapabilityGap closure, kit-map upgrade, supported assessment citation for an unchecked count, streak/reward or successful practice on disagreement. D38 must additionally prove LIVE presenter routing to authorized demo-operator, persona remaining SIM, no foreign episode/observation link, every Beat event with stored hub-derived time, and real UI Act 5 with dashed heart ring beside the measurement. Automated SIM/worker-fake software evidence is separate from the required consented LIVE presenter run; never claim SIM proves that hardware clause. P30-5 blocks incompatible presenter/SIM plan completion instead of weakening origin validation.

V86/T30-03/19/33/35: complete 65/60s versus 96, preserve both actual observations with methods/origins, flag difference without blame, state retry, plan step still open, no successful practice, no capability/diagnosis change. Retry retains previous manual/camera/Answer history and appends one new attempt; superseding Answer is at answer, current-attempt tokens reject delayed/reordered old packets, sequence duplicate same body is a no-op, conflicting body leaves an incomplete attempt. Test independent device/manual reference when actually present and absent, compare both sources separately, two cameras count as one. Cancel/refetch/restart must preserve history with null cancelled outcome and current observation link. Use actual E28/E31 consumers when testing their effects, not a fake complete_step call.

V87/T30-04/05/11: absent/refusing/low-quality/hung external camera with no device/model/link gives complete manual count, no_reference with reason, retained reading and explicit unchecked label. Actual assessment support validation must reject citing this as support. Optional independent reference absence stays absence. No fabricated value or fallback fixture when configuration/provider fails. Compare the permitted deterministic responses with model/link absent/up only through their owners' fixtures; teach never imports GroundLink.

V96/T30-20/21/22/25/31/36: real help session enters not_breathing, starts approved coaching pipeline, documented external FakeCompressionRatePort supplies below-band then cannot_see_hands at configured timestamps; rendered configured push-faster then no number, static line and byte-equivalent fixed help steps/state. Test actual E06 plugin refusal with the unvalidated production gate as a separate required case: always null, never a fake success or a tuned gate. Numeric worker performance needs frozen manikin evidence before any accuracy claim. Leaving/closing, hidden hands, silence, future/delayed/repeated samples, SSE loss, hub death, stale reconnect history and expired lease clear feedback; no unauthorized crew/station delivery despite crew event scope. Busy/missing camera, competing help/drill jobs, generation renewal and restart reconciliation show visible refusal and no lost fixed help. Drill end/expiry/restart return 404 for transient checks and all persistent stores including WAL/ledger/audit/outbox/worker remain free of drill values. Do not weaken the shared command policy to accomplish the scan; P30-6 must resolve it.

Critical-path fault scenarios T30-07/15/16/17/18/29/32/34/38: real subprocess kills before/after every state/Answer/attempt/Observation/audit/outbox/replication/command receipt/commit/ACK boundary; accepted result survives, uncommitted result stays absent, idempotent retry writes once and authorized durable receipt works after 24h. Crash mid count refuses an incomplete capture. Force actual disk-full/locked/I/O/integrity errors through E01's documented platform.testing fault seam, not monkeypatched repositories; inspect atomicity and retryable visible errors. Two real clients race finish/finish, finish/cancel, current release activation and lost response. Same key another target/parameter never replays success. Unknown/same-raw-different-segment clocks, UTC jumps/suspension, mission boundary and worker uncertainty cannot fabricate a full count or current sample. Zero/negative/empty/extreme/partial input and incompatible units refuse; conflicting sources are kept, never averaged. Saturate beat/worker capacities and hang external worker while measuring fixed help <=500ms on the reference rig; no local timeout/queue implementation. Missing/corrupt documents reject, last good persists, open checks/jobs stay pinned; cold reload renders original content, missing version fails explicitly. Keep independent manual E01 capture and cached/printed help available when guided capture is unavailable.

Privacy cases use valid IDs from another subject/run/role/drill, self-nominated helper, closed session, revoked grant, station and officer without field grants, and A/B owner switch. Prove both permitted narrow access and denied wider access through HTTP/SSE/late receipt/cache/export hooks, not deny-only tests. Incapacitated subject gets fixed help/manual care through the defined open-session path without invented consent. Reference-only errors/logs/audit and no journal/report leakage. Long ground outage never blocks the count or changes safety state; E29 owns backlog/delivery semantics, no new E30 exporter.

V98/T30-12/24/27/38: activate scratch label/phrase/step edits through the real config API without UI rebuild, assert visible change only on newly pinned work, unchanged old sessions/warnings, rejected corrupt update and unchanged safety mapping. E21's actual source/built scan covers the feature and refuses missing trees. All five skill entry paths, landmarks/notice/first-time instructions, bleeding question and sourced eye timer need T3 browser evidence; no placeholder text or viewer-only shortcut satisfies R51. T4 study CLI synthetic checks are not real participant evidence. Exercise approved hub-window-to-study export once P30-8 publishes the binding, respecting consent and missing-reference denominators.

Done requires every V/D and critical path above through the real stack, all T30 IDs accounted for across tasks, all gates, compatible fixture/base/effective/config/worker/protocol/build hashes, full assigned software suite and separate live/reference/venue evidence. E21 consumes test evidence only through approved handoff; do not create reports under its owned paths. Full hub and UI suites rerun after fixes. Per-file >=95% domain/application branch, full condition coverage and complexity <=15 on safety decisions, no unreviewed surviving capture/agreement mutants, correct import discovery, Schemathesis on all five operations, resolved senior review and CI are release requirements. A clean software run does not imply clinical validation or mission acceptance, and missing hardware/consent/manikin data remains explicitly unmeasured.
